instruction: Start with guih05_electrical_panel_seed.dxf in LibreCAD. On this machine, launch LibreCAD from `/usr/bin/librecad` before opening `guih05_electrical_panel_seed.dxf`. Complete the hard electrical panel. Draw PANEL rectangle (0,0)-(600,400), RAIL lines (40,290)-(560,290) and (40,180)-(560,180), twelve BREAKERS as 50 x 80 rectangles starting at x=60,135,210,285,360,435 on y=250 and y=140, a TERM strip rectangle (55,35)-(545,85) with vertical dividers every 45 mm from x=70 through x=520, WIRE duct rectangles (25,105)-(575,125) and (25,335)-(575,355), labels B1 through B12, and text MAIN 480V, 24VDC CONTROL, PE N L1 L2 L3, and PANEL E-104. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih05_electrical_panel_completed.dxf.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(10); pyautogui.press("enter")
